author: Philip K. Dick
card_summary: A six-page scan of undated pages from Dick's Exegesis, preserving pages 1 through 6 of the handwritten journal as raw archival images without established folder or dating context.
page_summary:
This document contains scanned images of six pages, numbered 1 through 6, from Dick's Exegesis. The source carries no confirmed date, so it stands apart from the folder-dated August 1978 scans and offers manuscript pages without a settled place in the journal's chronology.

As with the other raw scans in the portal, its worth is documentary. It preserves the primary text in Dick's own hand rather than in an editor's arrangement, and it lets researchers examine the material directly. Because the pages are undated and unplaced, any interpretation of their specific content should be made cautiously and cross-checked against the fuller archive.

The portal holds one archive manifestation. It is best used as a specimen of the manuscript, consulted alongside the published Sutin and Jackson-Lethem editions and the portal's Exegesis materials at /exegesis.
